name: B10-0023/2024 (PPE) – Situation in Venezuela
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament says the July 2024 Venezuelan election was not free or fair. It recognises opposition candidate Edmundo González Urrutia as the legitimate, democratically elected President of Venezuela. It calls on European Union member states to do the same. It rejects the official result announced by the regime-controlled electoral council and says the opposition's tally sheets show González won. It asks for sanctions on Nicolás Maduro and his inner circle, and for the release of political prisoners. This is the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** The Parliament formally backs González as Venezuela's elected President and asks European Union states to follow.
- **Who it affects:** Nicolás Maduro, his inner circle and officials of the electoral council, through calls for sanctions.
- **What happens next:** European Union states decide whether to recognise González, and the Parliament wants him to take office on 10 January 2025.
